caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile design divided vertically down the center into two equal halves. The left half has a dark navy blue background with an intricate light gray pattern depicting a symmetrical vase or urn containing multiple overlapping large fruits or gourds with striped patterns and surrounded by leafy branches with smaller round fruit clusters. On the right half, the same design is mirrored but with reversed colors: a light gray background filled with a navy blue pattern that matches the left side. The entire composition is bordered at the bottom by two horizontal stripes—one thicker and one thinner—in complementary colors to each half. The artwork is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Tyler Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
